title: Greedy Takahashi
constraintsSummary:
Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 10^5; 1 \leq A_i,B_i \leq N\ (1 \leq i \leq M); A_i 
eq B_i\ (1 \leq i \leq M); 1 \leq S_i \lt T_i \leq 10^9\ (1 \leq i \leq M); S_i 
eq S_j\ (i 
eq j); 1 \leq X_i \lt Z_i \leq 10^9\ (1 \leq i \leq Q); 1 \leq Y_i \leq N\ (1 \leq i \leq Q); All values in input are integers.
